name: Schedule
why: The work a project runs after the start, each lane held to one metric
ideal: Threads, scheduled tasks, guards, helpers and fixes run on time, stay safe and stop when the work is done.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Automate work with scheduled tasks

steps.name: Threads
steps.rule: A thread opens a draft pull request with attribution lines, and it is green on the first push.

steps.name: Tasks
steps.rule: A scheduled task ran on time, succeeded, and keeps its up-front connector load small.

steps.name: Hooks
steps.rule: A hook fires when it should, runs nothing unsafe and adds under a second.

steps.name: Subagents
steps.rule: The reviewer finds real defects, and the explorer answers a lookup in one pass on a small model.

steps.name: Auto fix
steps.rule: Auto fix pushes a fix with a test, never skips one, and stops when the pull request merges.

steps.name: Skills
steps.rule: A skill fires when its task comes up, and the thread finds it on the first try.
